description: A dark, weathered vintage car with its driver's door open, parked at dusk. On the cracked black leather back seat lie a gold tenor saxophone and a worn sunburst electric guitar, with a crumpled cloth beside them. Behind the car is an ocean with choppy waves, and a pier with a lit Ferris wheel, neon signs and a lone figure walking on the boardwalk. The painting is oil-style and fills the frame edge to edge.
